// Verifies the signed session tokens issued by this project's identity service. Generated by Tessery.

using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;

public record Session(string Sub, string Email, string Role, long Exp)
{
    static readonly byte[] Secret = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("AUTH_SECRET") ?? "");

    static byte[] FromBase64Url(string s)
    {
        s = s.Replace('-', '+').Replace('_', '/');
        return Convert.FromBase64String(s.PadRight(s.Length + (4 - s.Length % 4) % 4, '='));
    }

    public static Session? Verify(string? token)
    {
        if (token is null || Secret.Length == 0) return null;
        var parts = token.Split('.');
        if (parts.Length != 3) return null;
        try
        {
            var want = HMACSHA256.HashData(Secret, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(parts[0] + "." + parts[1]));
            if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(want, FromBase64Url(parts[2]))) return null;
            using var body = JsonDocument.Parse(FromBase64Url(parts[1]));
            var r = body.RootElement;
            string Text(string k) => r.TryGetProperty(k, out var v) && v.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String ? v.GetString()! : "";
            var exp = r.TryGetProperty("exp", out var e) && e.TryGetInt64(out var n) ? n : 0;
            if (exp < DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()) return null;
            return new Session(Text("sub"), Text("email"), Text("role"), exp);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Reads `Authorization: Bearer ...` or the `session` cookie.</summary>
    public static Session? From(HttpRequest req)
    {
        var auth = req.Headers.Authorization.ToString();
        if (auth.StartsWith("Bearer ")) return Verify(auth[7..]);
        return req.Cookies.TryGetValue("session", out var token) ? Verify(token) : null;
    }
}
